21	  def Float2Bits(x: Float): (Boolean, Int, Int) = {
22	    val abs = x.abs
23	    val int = java.lang.Float.floatToIntBits(abs)
24	
25	    val sign: Boolean = (x < 0)
26	    val exponent: Int = int >> 23
27	    val mantissa: Int = int & ((1 << 23) - 1)
28	
29	    (sign, exponent, mantissa)
30	  }
31	
32	  def EnqueueValid(fpu: Fpu, op: FpuOptype.Type, ina: Float, inb: Float, inc: Float, waddr: Int) = {
33	    fpu.io.cmd.valid.poke(1)
34	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.optype.poke(op)
35	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.waddr.poke(waddr)
36	
37	    val ina_bits = Float2Bits(ina)
38	    val inb_bits = Float2Bits(inb)
39	    val inc_bits = Float2Bits(inc)
40	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.ina.sign.poke(ina_bits._1)
41	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.ina.exponent.poke(ina_bits._2)
42	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.ina.mantissa.poke(ina_bits._3)
43	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.inb.sign.poke(inb_bits._1)
44	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.inb.exponent.poke(inb_bits._2)
45	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.inb.mantissa.poke(inb_bits._3)
46	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.inc.sign.poke(inc_bits._1)
47	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.inc.exponent.poke(inc_bits._2)
48	    fpu.io.cmd.bits.inc.mantissa.poke(inc_bits._3)
49	  }
50	
51	  def GetFloat(fpu: Fpu): Float = {
52	    val sign = fpu.io.output.bits.bits.sign.peek().litValue
53	    val exponent = fpu.io.output.bits.bits.exponent.peek().litValue
54	    val mantissa = fpu.io.output.bits.bits.mantissa.peek().litValue
55	    val int_val = ((exponent << 23) + mantissa).toInt
56	    val negate = if (sign == 1) -1.0f else 1.0f
57	
58	    negate * java.lang.Float.intBitsToFloat(int_val)
59	  }

62	    simulate(new Fpu) { dut =>
63	      dut.io.output.ready.poke(1)

62	      assert(rdata == testData, s"Expected 0x${testData.toString(16)}, got 0x${rdata.toString(16)}")
63

66	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x20.U, testData2.U, 0xffff.U, 4.U, 1.U)

67	  def memWrite32(mem: scala.collection.mutable.Map[Long, Byte], addr: Long, value: Long): Unit = {
68	    for (i <- 0 until 4) mem(addr + i) = ((value >> (i * 8)) & 0xff).toByte

74	    for (i <- 0 until 4) v |= (mem.getOrElse(addr + i, 0.toByte).toLong & 0xff) << (i * 8)

78	  /** Build a 32-byte descriptor in memory. */
79	  def buildDescriptor(
80	      mem: scala.collection.mutable.Map[Long, Byte],
81	      descAddr: Long,
82	      srcAddr: Long,
83	      dstAddr: Long,
84	      xferLen: Int,
85	      xferWidth: Int = 2,
86	      srcFixed: Boolean = false,
87	      dstFixed: Boolean = false,
88	      pollEn: Boolean = false,
89	      nextDesc: Long = 0,
90	      pollAddr: Long = 0,
91	      pollMask: Long = 0,
92	      pollValue: Long = 0
93	  ): Unit = {
94	    memWrite32(mem, descAddr + 0x00, srcAddr)
95	    memWrite32(mem, descAddr + 0x04, dstAddr)
96	    val flags = (xferLen & 0xffffff).toLong |
97	      ((xferWidth & 0x7).toLong << 24) |
98	      ((if (srcFixed) 1L else 0L) << 27) |
99	      ((if (dstFixed) 1L else 0L) << 28) |
100	      ((if (pollEn) 1L else 0L) << 29)
101	    memWrite32(mem, descAddr + 0x08, flags)
102	    memWrite32(mem, descAddr + 0x0c, nextDesc)
103	    memWrite32(mem, descAddr + 0x10, pollAddr)
104	    memWrite32(mem, descAddr + 0x14, pollMask)
105	    memWrite32(mem, descAddr + 0x18, pollValue)
106	    memWrite32(mem, descAddr + 0x1c, 0)
107	  }

109	  /** Reactive memory model: step clock while servicing host port transactions. Runs for `maxCycles`
110	    * or until DMA is no longer busy.
111	    *
112	    * Timing: In Chisel sim, poke is combinational (immediate), step advances the clock. We keep
113	    * a.ready=1. When a.valid is seen (peek), that means on the NEXT step, fire will occur. We
114	    * capture the request, step (fire happens, DMA transitions), then present D response, step again
115	    * (D fire happens).
116	    */
117	  def runDmaWithMemory(
118	      dut: DmaEngine,
119	      mem: scala.collection.mutable.Map[Long, Byte],
120	      maxCycles: Int = 2000
121	  ): Int = {
122	    val host     = dut.io.tl_host
123	    var txnCount = 0
124	
125	    for (cycle <- 0 until maxCycles) {
126	      // Default: ready to accept A, no D response
127	      host.a.ready.poke(true.B)
128	      host.d.valid.poke(false.B)
129	
130	      // Check if DMA is presenting an A channel request
131	      if (host.a.valid.peek().litValue != 0) {
132	        // Capture request details (they're combinationally valid now)
133	        val opcode  = host.a.bits.opcode.peek().litValue.toInt
134	        val address = host.a.bits.address.peek().litValue.toLong
135	        val size    = host.a.bits.size.peek().litValue.toInt
136	        val nbytes  = 1 << size
137	        val wdata   = host.a.bits.data.peek().litValue
138	
139	        // Step: a.fire occurs (valid=1, ready=1 on this edge)
140	        dut.clock.step()
141	
142	        // Now DMA has moved to response-wait state.
143	        // Present D channel response.
144	        host.a.ready.poke(false.B)
145	        host.d.valid.poke(true.B)
146	        host.d.bits.source.poke(0.U)
147	        host.d.bits.error.poke(false.B)
148	        host.d.bits.sink.poke(0.U)
149	        host.d.bits.param.poke(0.U)
150	        host.d.bits.size.poke(size.U)
151	
152	        if (opcode == 4) {
153	          // Get: read from mem, place data at correct byte lane per TL-UL spec
154	          var rdata      = BigInt(0)
155	          val busBytes   = 16 // 128-bit bus
156	          val byteOffset = (address % busBytes).toInt
157	          for (i <- 0 until nbytes) {
158	            val b = mem.getOrElse(address + i, 0.toByte) & 0xff
159	            rdata = rdata | (BigInt(b) << ((byteOffset + i) * 8))
160	          }
161	          host.d.bits.opcode.poke(1.U) // AccessAckData
162	          host.d.bits.data.poke(rdata.U)
163	        } else {
164	          // PutFullData: write to mem, extract data from correct byte lane
165	          val busBytes   = 16 // 128-bit bus
166	          val byteOffset = (address % busBytes).toInt
167	          for (i <- 0 until nbytes) {
168	            mem(address + i) = ((wdata >> ((byteOffset + i) * 8)) & 0xff).toByte
169	          }
170	          host.d.bits.opcode.poke(0.U) // AccessAck
171	          host.d.bits.data.poke(0.U)
172	        }
173	
174	        // Wait for D to be accepted
175	        var dWait = 0
176	        while (host.d.ready.peek().litValue == 0 && dWait < 100) {
177	          dut.clock.step()
178	          dWait += 1
179	        }
180	        // Step: d.fire occurs
181	        dut.clock.step()
182	        host.d.valid.poke(false.B)
183	        txnCount += 1
184	      } else {
185	        dut.clock.step()
186	      }
187	    }
188	    txnCount
189	  }

65	  // TileLink auto-responder (mirrors spi_v2_tb_top.sv)
66	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	  // V2 TL-A is 217 bits: Cat(opcode(3), param(3), size(4), source(8),
68	  //   addr(32), mask(16), data(128), user(23))
69	  // V2 TL-D is 162 bits: Cat(opcode(3), param(3), size(4), source(8),
70	  //   sink(1), data(128), user(14), error(1))
71	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

85	  // Single-driver style: accept A → latch + deassert ready; D handshake → clear + reassert
86	  val acceptA   = aValid && tlAReady && !respPending
87	  val completeD = respPending && v2.io.q_tl_d.ready
88	
89	  respPending := Mux(acceptA, true.B, Mux(completeD, false.B, respPending))
90	  respReq     := Mux(acceptA, aData, respReq)
91	  tlAReady    := Mux(acceptA, false.B, Mux(completeD, true.B, tlAReady))

95	  val reqParam  = respReq.param
96	  val reqSize   = respReq.size
97	  val reqSource = respReq.source
98	  val reqAddr   = respReq.address

105	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.opcode := respOpcode.asUInt
106	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.param  := 0.U(3.W)
107	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.size   := reqSize
108	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.source := reqSource
109	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.sink   := 0.U(1.W)
110	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.data   := respData
111	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.user   := 0.U.asTypeOf(new OpenTitanTileLink_D_User)
112	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.error  := 0.U(1.W)

115	  // TL-A capture registers (latch on A-channel handshake)
116	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
117	  val aHandshake = aValid && tlAReady
118	  val captured   = RegInit(false.B)
119	  val capOpcode  = RegInit(0.U(3.W))
120	  val capAddress = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
121	  val capData    = RegInit(0.U(128.W))

126	  val firstCapAddress = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
127	  val firstCapData    = RegInit(0.U(128.W))

132	  capAddress := Mux(aHandshake, aData.address, capAddress)
133	  capData    := Mux(aHandshake, aData.data, capData)
134	  capCount   := Mux(aHandshake, capCount + 1.U, capCount)

137	    firstCapDone    := false.B
138	    firstCapAddress := 0.U
139	    firstCapData    := 0.U
140	  }.elsewhen(aHandshake && !firstCapDone) {
141	    firstCapAddress := aData.address
142	    firstCapData    := aData.data

144	  }

149	  io.tl_a_cap_data      := capData

160	
161	  // Sys clock period = 10 units (SYS_HALF=5), SPI period = 13 units (SPI_HALF=6.5).
162	  // We use integer ratio: SYS_HALF=10, SPI_HALF=13.
163	  // Each clock.step(1) is one "sim unit". SPI toggles when the phase counter says so.
164	  val SYS_HALF = 10
165	  val SPI_HALF = 13
166	
167	  /** Run the simulation with dual-clock stepping. The main clock.step() drives the sys domain. SPI
168	    * clock is toggled as a Bool input at a 10:13 ratio to approximate truly async clocks.
169	    */
170	  def withDualClock(body: Spi2TLULV2TestWrapper => Unit): Unit = {
171	    simulate(new Spi2TLULV2TestWrapper) { dut =>
172	      // Reset — toggle SPI clock during reset so system-reset-only
173	      // CDC FIFOs (clocked by spi_clk) see the reset posedge.
174	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
175	      dut.io.spi_csb.poke(true.B)
176	      dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
177	      dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(false.B)
178	      dut.io.tl_a_first_reset.poke(false.B)
179	      for (_ <- 0 until 5) {
180	        dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(true.B)
181	        dut.clock.step(1)
182	        dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(false.B)
183	        dut.clock.step(1)
184	      }
185	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
186	      dut.clock.step(5)
187	
188	      body(dut)
189	    }
190	  }

192	  /** Dual-clock tick state — tracks when to toggle SPI clock relative to sys clock. */
193	  class DualClockState(dut: Spi2TLULV2TestWrapper) {
194	    var sysTime: Long     = 0
195	    var nextSysEdge: Long = SYS_HALF
196	    var nextSpiEdge: Long = SPI_HALF
197	    var spiLevel: Boolean = false
198	
199	    /** Advance one sim time unit, toggling whichever clock(s) fire. Returns 's', 'p', or 'b'. */
200	    def tick(): Char = {
201	      if (nextSysEdge < nextSpiEdge) {
202	        sysTime = nextSysEdge
203	        nextSysEdge += SYS_HALF
204	        dut.clock.step(1)
205	        's'
206	      } else if (nextSpiEdge < nextSysEdge) {
207	        sysTime = nextSpiEdge
208	        spiLevel = !spiLevel
209	        dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(spiLevel.B)
210	        nextSpiEdge += SPI_HALF
211	        // Don't step sys clock — just toggle SPI
212	        // But we need at least one eval to propagate. Step sys clock to advance simulation.
213	        dut.clock.step(1)
214	        'p'
215	      } else {
216	        // Both edges coincide
217	        sysTime = nextSysEdge
218	        spiLevel = !spiLevel
219	        dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(spiLevel.B)
220	        nextSysEdge += SYS_HALF
221	        nextSpiEdge += SPI_HALF
222	        dut.clock.step(1)
223	        'b'
224	      }
225	    }
226	
227	    /** Advance until n SPI posedges have occurred. */
228	    def spiCycles(n: Int): Unit = {
229	      var count = 0
230	      while (count < n) {
231	        val w = tick()
232	        if ((w == 'p' || w == 'b') && spiLevel) count += 1
233	      }
234	    }
235	
236	    /** Advance until n sys posedges have occurred. */
237	    def bothCycles(n: Int): Unit = {
238	      var count = 0
239	      while (count < n) {
240	        val w = tick()
241	        if (w == 's' || w == 'b') count += 1
242	      }
243	    }
244	
245	    // SPI protocol helpers
246	
247	    def spiXferByte(tx: Int): Unit = {
248	      for (bit <- 7 to 0 by -1) {
249	        dut.io.spi_mosi.poke((((tx >> bit) & 1) != 0).B)
250	        spiCycles(1)
251	      }
252	    }
253	
254	    def spiRecvByte(): Int = {
255	      var rx = 0
256	      for (_ <- 7 to 0 by -1) {
257	        dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
258	        spiCycles(1)
259	        rx = (rx << 1) | (if (dut.io.spi_miso.peek().litValue != 0) 1 else 0)
260	      }
261	      rx
262	    }
263	
264	    def csbAssert(): Unit = {
265	      dut.io.spi_csb.poke(false.B)
266	      dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
267	    }
268	
269	    def csbDeassert(): Unit = {
270	      dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
271	      // Let DmaEngine finish draining CDC FIFOs before CSB deasserts
272	      // (AsyncQueue safe mode coordinates reset on CSB deassert)
273	      bothCycles(500)
274	      dut.io.spi_csb.poke(true.B)
275	      bothCycles(50)
276	    }
277	
278	    def spiSendHeader(op: Int, addr: Long, len: Int): Unit = {
279	      spiXferByte(op & 0xff)
280	      spiXferByte(((addr >> 24) & 0xff).toInt)
281	      spiXferByte(((addr >> 16) & 0xff).toInt)
282	      spiXferByte(((addr >> 8) & 0xff).toInt)
283	      spiXferByte((addr & 0xff).toInt)
284	      spiXferByte((len >> 8) & 0xff)
285	      spiXferByte(len & 0xff)
286	    }
287	
288	    /** Collect n raw MISO bits. Returns array of bytes packed MSB-first per byte. */
289	    def collectMisoBits(nbits: Int): Array[Int] = {
290	      val buf = new Array[Int]((nbits + 7) / 8)
291	      for (i <- 0 until nbits) {
292	        dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
293	        spiCycles(1)
294	        val byteIdx = i / 8
295	        val bitIdx  = 7 - (i % 8)
296	        if (dut.io.spi_miso.peek().litValue != 0) {
297	          buf(byteIdx) |= (1 << bitIdx)
298	        }
299	      }
300	      buf
301	    }
302	
303	    /** Wait for TL-A capture count to reach expected value. */
304	    def waitTlACapture(expectedCount: Long, timeoutSys: Int = 200): Boolean = {
305	      var sc = 0
306	      while (sc < timeoutSys) {
307	        val w = tick()
308	        if (w == 's' || w == 'b') {
309	          sc += 1
310	          if (dut.io.tl_a_cap_count.peek().litValue >= expectedCount) return true
311	        }
312	      }
313	      false
314	    }
315	
316	    /** Reset the first-beat capture registers so the next A-channel handshake is captured. */
317	    def resetFirstCapture(): Unit = {
318	      dut.io.tl_a_first_reset.poke(true.B)
319	      dut.clock.step(1)
320	      dut.io.tl_a_first_reset.poke(false.B)
321	    }
322	
323	    /** Send a multi-beat write frame: header(op=0x02, addr, len=numBeats-1) + numBeats*16 payload
324	      * bytes.
325	      */
326	    def spiWriteMulti(addr: Long, beats: Seq[Array[Int]]): Unit = {
327	      csbAssert()
328	      spiSendHeader(0x02, addr, beats.length - 1)
329	      for (beat <- beats; byte <- beat) spiXferByte(byte)
330	      csbDeassert()
331	    }
332	
333	  }

335	  /** Search for a bit pattern (needle) in a bit buffer (haystack). Both are packed MSB-first per
336	    * byte. Returns bit offset or -1.
337	    */
338	  def findBitPattern(
339	      haystack: Array[Int],
340	      hayBits: Int,
341	      needle: Array[Int],
342	      needleBits: Int
343	  ): Int = {
344	    for (off <- 0 to (hayBits - needleBits)) {
345	      var matched = true
346	      var b       = 0
347	      while (b < needleBits && matched) {
348	        val hi     = off + b
349	        val hayBit = (haystack(hi / 8) >> (7 - (hi % 8))) & 1
350	        val ndlBit = (needle(b / 8) >> (7 - (b     % 8))) & 1
351	        if (hayBit != ndlBit) matched = false
352	        b += 1
353	      }
354	      if (matched) return off
355	    }
356	    -1
357	  }
